decision: 5 second time penalty. (1 penalty point awarded, 5 points in total for the 12 month period)
event_name: Date 13 May 2018 Time 15:51 2018 SPANISH GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 May 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 2 left the track and did not stay to the left of the bollard when re-joining the track, contrary to the Event Notes point 9.
offence: Breach of Article 12.1.1 i. of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and the driver of car 2 left the track at turn 2 and did not pass to the left of the bollard just before Turn 3 as per the instructions in the Race Director's event notes. Tim Mayer Andrew Mallalieu Derek Warwick David Domingo
title: 2018 Spanish Grand Prix 2018 Offence Car 2 Re Joining The Track Doc 36
